title: Borrowed bears: how China lends pandas, and leverages them

words.note: borrow 是借入，lend 是借出。I borrowed a book from the library. The library lent me a book.
words.ctx: Borrowed bears: how China lends pandas, and leverages them

ex.en: She [[borrowed]] three books from the library.
ex.zh: 她从图书馆借了三本书。

ex.en: Can I [[borrow]] your umbrella?
ex.zh: 我能借一下你的伞吗？

ex.en: The museum [[lent out]] paintings to other galleries.
ex.zh: 博物馆把画借给了其他美术馆。

ex.en: They [[lent]] their car [[out]] to a neighbour.
ex.zh: 他们把车借给了邻居。

ex.en: The company [[leveraged]] its brand to enter new markets.
ex.zh: 公司利用自己的品牌进入新市场。

ex.en: She [[leveraged]] her network to find a job.
ex.zh: 她利用自己的人脉找工作。

words.note: 形容数额、体积等很大。a hefty fine（一大笔罚款），a hefty meal（一顿丰盛的饭）。
words.ctx: No panda truly leaves China. The country lends them out for hefty fees and considerable soft power, and takes them back whenever it chooses.

ex.en: He received a [[hefty]] bonus at year-end.
ex.zh: 他年底拿到了一大笔奖金。

ex.en: The fine was a [[hefty]] sum.
ex.zh: 罚款是一大笔钱。

cloze.before: No panda truly leaves China. The country lends them out for
cloze.after: fees and considerable soft power, and takes them back whenever it chooses.
cloze.szh: 没有哪只大熊猫真正离开中国。国家以高昂的费用和相当大的软实力为条件把它们借出去，又随时可以把它们收回来。

words.note: 靠吸引和说服（而非武力）来影响别国的能力。文化、体育、教育都算软实力。
words.ctx: No panda truly leaves China. The country lends them out for hefty fees and considerable soft power, and takes them back whenever it chooses.

ex.en: Pop music is part of a country's [[soft power]].
ex.zh: 流行音乐是一个国家软实力的一部分。

ex.en: The film festival boosted the nation's [[soft power]].
ex.zh: 电影节提升了该国的软实力。

cloze.after: , and takes them back whenever it chooses.
cloze.szh: 没有哪只大熊猫真正离开中国。国家以高昂的费用和相当大的软实力为条件把它们借出去，又随时可以把它们收回来。

words.note: 专指食肉动物的幼崽。小熊叫 bear cub，小虎叫 tiger cub。
words.ctx: Every cub born abroad belongs to Beijing, and goes home before it turns four.

ex.en: The [[cub]] clung to its mother.
ex.zh: 幼崽紧紧贴着妈妈。

ex.en: Two [[cubs]] were born at the zoo last spring.
ex.zh: 去年春天动物园出生了两只幼崽。

cloze.before: Every
cloze.after: born abroad belongs to Beijing, and goes home before it turns four.
cloze.szh: 每只在海外出生的幼崽都归北京所有，四岁前就要回国。

words.note: 也可以说 date back to。表示某事物的起源时间。
words.ctx: The arrangement dates to 1972, when Mao Zedong gifted a pair of pandas to America after Richard Nixon's visit.

ex.en: The tradition [[dates to]] the 15th century.
ex.zh: 这个传统可以追溯到十五世纪。

ex.en: The castle [[dates back to]] 1200.
ex.zh: 这座城堡始建于 1200 年。

cloze.before: The arrangement
cloze.after: 1972, when Mao Zedong gifted a pair of pandas to America after Richard Nixon's visit.
cloze.szh: 这一做法可以追溯到 1972 年，当时毛泽东在理查德·尼克松访华之后赠送了一对大熊猫给美国。

words.note: a pair of shoes / gloves / pandas。两件配在一起用的东西。
words.ctx: The arrangement dates to 1972, when Mao Zedong gifted a pair of pandas to America after Richard Nixon's visit.

ex.en: She bought [[a pair of]] earrings.
ex.zh: 她买了一对耳环。

ex.en: I need [[a pair of]] chopsticks.
ex.zh: 我需要一双筷子。

words.note: gift 作动词比 give 更正式，常用于官方赠送。
words.ctx: The arrangement dates to 1972, when Mao Zedong gifted a pair of pandas to America after Richard Nixon's visit.

ex.en: The mayor [[gifted]] a painting to the school.
ex.zh: 市长把一幅画赠送给了学校。

ex.en: They [[gifted]] her a laptop for graduation.
ex.zh: 他们送了她一台笔记本电脑作为毕业礼物。

cloze.before: The arrangement dates to 1972, when Mao Zedong
cloze.after: a pair of pandas to America after Richard Nixon's visit.
cloze.szh: 这一做法可以追溯到 1972 年，当时毛泽东在理查德·尼克松访华之后赠送了一对大熊猫给美国。

words.note: 当形容词用：彻底的、完全的。当副词用：毫不犹豫地、公开地。
words.ctx: Those were outright gifts. Today the bears are strictly on loan, at around a million dollars a year per pair.

ex.en: It was an [[outright]] victory.
ex.zh: 这是一场完胜。

ex.en: She [[outright]] refused to help.
ex.zh: 她断然拒绝了帮忙。

cloze.before: Those were
cloze.after: gifts. Today the bears are strictly on loan, at around a million dollars a year per pair.
cloze.szh: 那时是完全的赠予。如今大熊猫严格来说是租借的，每对每年约一百万美元。

words.note: The painting is on loan from the Louvre.（这幅画是从卢浮宫借来的。）
words.ctx: Those were outright gifts. Today the bears are strictly on loan, at around a million dollars a year per pair.

ex.en: The exhibit is [[on loan]] from a private collection.
ex.zh: 展品来自私人收藏的借展。

ex.en: The player is [[on loan]] from another club.
ex.zh: 这名球员是从另一个俱乐部租借来的。

cloze.before: Those were outright gifts. Today the bears are strictly
cloze.after: , at around a million dollars a year per pair.
cloze.szh: 那时是完全的赠予。如今大熊猫严格来说是租借的，每对每年约一百万美元。

words.note: 强调严格遵守、不含糊。strictly speaking（严格来说）。
words.ctx: Those were outright gifts. Today the bears are strictly on loan, at around a million dollars a year per pair.

ex.en: This is [[strictly]] between us.
ex.zh: 这件事只有你我知道，绝不外传。

ex.en: [[Strictly]] speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
ex.zh: 严格来说，番茄是一种水果。

cloze.before: Those were outright gifts. Today the bears are
cloze.after: on loan, at around a million dollars a year per pair.
cloze.szh: 那时是完全的赠予。如今大熊猫严格来说是租借的，每对每年约一百万美元。

words.note: It's a privilege to meet you.（见到您是荣幸。）
words.ctx: Zoos queue for the privilege, and a lucky few secure a pair.

ex.en: Education is a [[privilege]] in some countries.
ex.zh: 在某些国家，教育是一种特权。

ex.en: It was a [[privilege]] to work with her.
ex.zh: 能和她共事是一种荣幸。

cloze.before: Zoos queue for the
cloze.after: , and a lucky few secure a pair.
cloze.szh: 各动物园争相争取这一特权，少数幸运的获得了一对。

words.note: few 单独用表示“几乎没有”，a few 表示“几个”，a lucky few 指“少数幸运的（人或物）”。
words.ctx: Zoos queue for the privilege, and a lucky few secure a pair.

ex.en: Many applied; [[a lucky few]] were chosen.
ex.zh: 很多人申请了，少数幸运者被选中。

ex.en: Only [[a lucky few]] saw the meteor shower.
ex.zh: 只有少数幸运的人看到了流星雨。

cloze.before: Zoos queue for the privilege, and a
cloze.after: secure a pair.
cloze.szh: 各动物园争相争取这一特权，少数幸运的获得了一对。

words.zh: 获得；弄到（不易得到的东西）
words.note: secure 作动词比 get 更正式，强调经过努力获得。
words.ctx: Zoos queue for the privilege, and a lucky few secure a pair.

ex.en: He [[secured]] a loan from the bank.
ex.zh: 他从银行拿到了贷款。

ex.en: The team [[secured]] a spot in the finals.
ex.zh: 队伍获得了决赛的名额。

cloze.before: Zoos queue for the privilege, and a lucky few
cloze.after: a pair.

words.note: give sth and get sth in return（给出去某物，换回某物作为回报）。
words.ctx: In return they build a forested enclosure, commit to bamboo shipments and pledge funds for conservation in China.

ex.en: She helped him; [[in return]], he bought her dinner.
ex.zh: 她帮了他；作为回报，他请她吃晚饭。

ex.en: They want nothing [[in return]].
ex.zh: 他们不要任何回报。

cloze.after: they build a forested enclosure, commit to bamboo shipments and pledge funds for conservation in China.
cloze.szh: 作为回报，它们要建造一个林围栏，承诺竹子的定期运送，并保证为中国的保护工作提供资金。

words.note: commit to + 名词或 -ing。The company committed to reducing emissions.
words.ctx: In return they build a forested enclosure, commit to bamboo shipments and pledge funds for conservation in China.

ex.en: She [[committed to]] saving 10% of her salary.
ex.zh: 她承诺把工资的 10% 存起来。

ex.en: The government [[committed]] funds [[to]] the project.
ex.zh: 政府向该项目拨了资金。

cloze.before: In return they build a forested enclosure,
cloze.after: bamboo shipments and pledge funds for conservation in China.
cloze.szh: 作为回报，它们要建造一个林围栏，承诺竹子的定期运送，并保证为中国的保护工作提供资金。

words.note: pledge money / support：保证给予金钱或支持。比 promise 更正式。
words.ctx: In return they build a forested enclosure, commit to bamboo shipments and pledge funds for conservation in China.

ex.en: He [[pledged]] a million dollars to the charity.
ex.zh: 他向慈善机构认捐了一百万美元。

ex.en: They [[pledged]] to rebuild the school.
ex.zh: 他们承诺重建学校。

cloze.before: In return they build a forested enclosure, commit to bamboo shipments and
cloze.after: funds for conservation in China.

words.note: frame 本义是“装框架”，引申为“用某种说法来描述”。
words.ctx: The money is framed as research funding, not rent.

ex.en: The tax was [[framed as]] a health measure.
ex.zh: 这项税被说成是健康措施。

ex.en: She [[framed]] the question [[as]] a suggestion.
ex.zh: 她把问题包装成了一个建议。

cloze.before: The money is
cloze.after: as research funding, not rent.
cloze.szh: 这笔钱被称作研究经费，而不是租金。

words.note: cynic 认为人的行为都出于自私。形容词 cynical。
words.ctx: Cynics call it a panda tax.

ex.en: [[Cynics]] said the donation was for publicity.
ex.zh: 持怀疑态度的人说那笔捐款是为了出风头。

ex.en: Don't be a [[cynic]] — sometimes people are genuinely kind.
ex.zh: 别总怀疑别人的动机——有时候人是真心善意的。

cloze.after: call it a panda tax.
cloze.szh: 持怀疑态度的人称之为熊猫税。

words.zh: 自己挣回成本；自给自足
words.note: 表示某物能自己产出价值来抵消成本。
words.ctx: The bears pay their way in other ways, too.

ex.en: The cafe [[paid its way]] within a year.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆一年内就自负盈亏了。

ex.en: He worked to [[pay his way]] through college.
ex.zh: 他打工挣钱读完大学。

cloze.before: The bears
cloze.after: in other ways, too.
cloze.hint: 自己挣回成本；自给自足
cloze.szh: 大熊猫在其他方面也能自己挣回成本。

words.note: 作形容词：常驻的。作名词：居民。a resident panda = 常驻大熊猫。
words.ctx: A resident panda can boost a zoo's footfall by half, and merchandise sells briskly.

ex.en: The zoo's [[resident]] tiger is a big attraction.
ex.zh: 动物园常驻的老虎是一大看点。

ex.en: Local [[residents]] protested the plan.
ex.zh: 当地居民抗议了该计划。

cloze.after: panda can boost a zoo's footfall by half, and merchandise sells briskly.
cloze.szh: 一只常驻大熊猫可以使动物园的客流量增长一半，周边商品也卖得很火。

words.note: boost sales / confidence / numbers：提升销量/信心/数字。
words.ctx: A resident panda can boost a zoo's footfall by half, and merchandise sells briskly.

ex.en: The ad campaign [[boosted]] sales by 20%.
ex.zh: 广告活动让销量增长了 20%。

ex.en: Good news [[boosted]] her confidence.
ex.zh: 好消息增强了她的信心。

ex.en: The new mall has seen a drop in [[footfall]].
ex.zh: 新商场的客流量下降了。

ex.en: High [[footfall]] means more sales.
ex.zh: 客流量大意味着更多销售。

words.note: recoup one's investment / costs / losses：收回投资/成本/损失。
words.ctx: Some zoos have recouped their annual fee within months of a panda's debut.

ex.en: The company [[recouped]] its losses within a year.
ex.zh: 公司在一年内弥补了损失。

ex.en: She [[recouped]] her investment by selling the flat.

words.note: 可当名词或动词。读音为 /ˈdeɪbjuː/，来自法语，t 不发音。
words.ctx: Some zoos have recouped their annual fee within months of a panda's debut.

ex.en: The singer made her [[debut]] at 16.
ex.zh: 这位歌手 16 岁首次登台。

words.note: diplomatic relations（外交关系），diplomatic signal（外交信号）。
words.ctx: Yet the bears are not merely a draw; they are a diplomatic signal.

ex.en: The two countries broke [[diplomatic]] ties.
ex.zh: 两国断绝了外交关系。

ex.en: Her answer was [[diplomatic]].
ex.zh: 她的回答很圆滑。

cloze.before: Yet the bears are not merely a draw; they are a
cloze.after: signal.
cloze.szh: 然而大熊猫不只是招揽游客的招牌，它们还是一个外交信号。

words.note: 本义是变酸，引申为关系等恶化。sour relations / sour a deal。
words.ctx: When they sour, pandas come home.

ex.en: The dispute [[soured]] relations between the two teams.
ex.zh: 争端恶化了两支队伍之间的关系。

ex.en: The deal [[soured]] after weeks of talks.
ex.zh: 经过数周谈判，交易泡汤了。

cloze.before: When they

words.note: 后面常接事件、冲突、混乱等。amid the chaos（在混乱之中）。

ex.zh: 公司在一场丑闻中倒闭了。

ex.en: [[Amid]] the noise, nobody heard the alarm.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂声中，没人听到警报。

words.ctx: In 2023, amid a long trade dispute with America, China let its loans lapse and recalled the pandas from Washington's National Zoo.

ex.zh: 公司召回了 10,000 辆汽车进行安全检查。

cloze.after: the pandas from Washington's National Zoo.
cloze.szh: 2023 年，在中美长期的贸易争端中，中国没有续签租借协议，召回了华盛顿国家动物园的大熊猫。

words.note: coincide /ˌkəʊɪnˈsaɪd/。两个事件在同一时间发生。
words.ctx: Weeks later, a pair in Edinburgh was sent home too and not replaced, coinciding with chillier ties with Britain.

ex.en: His visit [[coincided with]] the festival.
ex.zh: 他的到访恰逢节日。

ex.en: The price rise [[coincided]] with a shortage of supply.
ex.zh: 涨价恰好发生在供应短缺的时候。

cloze.before: Weeks later, a pair in Edinburgh was sent home too and not replaced,
cloze.after: with chillier ties with Britain.
cloze.szh: 几周后，爱丁堡的一对大熊猫也被送回国，且没有新的接替，恰逢中英关系转冷。

words.note: breeding programme（繁育项目），breeding season（繁殖季节）。
words.ctx: Pandas are also, quietly, a breeding bet.

ex.en: The zoo runs a [[breeding]] programme for rare turtles.
ex.zh: 动物园有一个稀有龟类的繁育项目。

ex.en: Spring is the [[breeding]] season for most birds.
ex.zh: 春天是大多数鸟类的繁殖季节。

cloze.before: Pandas are also, quietly, a
cloze.after: bet.
cloze.szh: 大熊猫也在悄悄地成为一场繁殖赌注。

words.zh: 徘徊；维持在某一水平上下
words.note: 数字在某水平上下波动用 hover。Unemployment hovers around 5%。
words.ctx: The population in the wild hovers near 1,800, and genetic diversity matters.

ex.en: Inflation [[hovers]] near 3%.
ex.zh: 通胀率徘徊在 3% 上下。

ex.en: The bird [[hovered]] above the water.
ex.zh: 鸟在水面上悬停。

cloze.before: The population in the wild
cloze.after: near 1,800, and genetic diversity matters.
cloze.hint: 徘徊；维持在某一水平上下
cloze.szh: 野生种群数量徘徊在 1,800 上下，基因多样性很重要。

words.note: broaden one's horizons（开阔眼界），broaden the gene pool（拓宽基因库）。
words.ctx: Each foreign-born cub broadens the gene pool slightly, which conservationists welcome.

ex.en: Travel can [[broaden]] your horizons.
ex.zh: 旅行能开阔眼界。

ex.en: The road was [[broadened]] to four lanes.
ex.zh: 马路被拓宽到了四车道。

cloze.before: Each foreign-born cub
cloze.after: the gene pool slightly, which conservationists welcome.
cloze.szh: 每一只国外出生的幼崽都会略微拓宽基因库，这是保护工作者所乐见的。

words.note: state（国家）+ craft（手艺）= 治国的手艺。
words.ctx: Whether the strategy owes more to science or statecraft is debatable, but the bears do not seem to mind.

ex.en: The treaty was a triumph of [[statecraft]].
ex.zh: 这条约是治国手腕的胜利。

ex.en: He wrote a book on modern [[statecraft]].
ex.zh: 他写了一本关于现代治国术的书。

cloze.before: Whether the strategy owes more to science or
cloze.after: is debatable, but the bears do not seem to mind.
cloze.szh: 这一策略更多是出于科学还是政治手腕，尚有争议，但大熊猫似乎并不介意。

words.note: It is debatable whether ...：……尚有争议。
words.ctx: Whether the strategy owes more to science or statecraft is debatable, but the bears do not seem to mind.

ex.en: It is [[debatable]] whether the plan will work.
ex.zh: 这个计划是否行得通还有争议。

ex.en: His claim is highly [[debatable]].
ex.zh: 他的说法大有争议。

cloze.before: Whether the strategy owes more to science or statecraft is
cloze.after: , but the bears do not seem to mind.
cloze.szh: 这一策略更多是出于科学还是政治手腕，尚有争议，但大熊猫似乎并不介意。

words.note: weave 的过去式是 wove，过去分词是 woven。be woven into = 被融入、被编织进。
words.ctx: Few animals have been so thoroughly woven into a country's foreign policy.

ex.en: Music is [[woven into]] everyday life here.
ex.zh: 音乐融入了这里的日常生活。

ex.en: She [[wove]] the story [[into]] her speech.
ex.zh: 她把故事编进了演讲中。

cloze.before: Few animals have been so thoroughly
cloze.after: into a country's foreign policy.
cloze.szh: 很少有动物被如此彻底地编织进一个国家的外交政策中。
